theorems.name: Submission.ted_allard_density_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ p : ℝ, (n : ℝ) < p → ∃ C δP : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ 0 < δP ∧ δP ≤ 1 / 8 ∧ C * δP ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (δ ρ : ℝ), 0 < δ → δ ≤ δP → V.AllardHypotheses H p δ ρ → (∀ y : Amb n ℓ, ‖y‖ ≤ 3 * δ * ρ → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ ρ / 2 → V.weight (closedBall y s) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + C * δ) * (unitBallVolume n * s ^ n))) ∧ (∀ y ∈ V.support, ‖y‖ ≤ 3 * δ * ρ → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ ρ / 2 → ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - C * δ) * (unitBallVolume n * s ^ n)) ≤ V.weight (closedBall y s)) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ‖x‖ ≤ 3 * δ * ρ → V.mult x ≤ 1 + C * δ) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) ((V.support ∩ ball 0 ρ) \ V.carrier) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
